items.question: How do I create a profile?
items.answer: Open Profile and complete your account details. If you're a studio owner, add your studio information too.

items.question: Where can I find my collections?
items.answer: Go to Collections from your Profile menu. You can create and manage collections from there.

items.question: How do privacy settings work?
items.answer: Use Privacy & Security in your Profile to adjust what information is shown and how your activity is handled.

items.question: I forgot my password
items.answer: Use the "Forgot Password" option on the login screen to reset using your email.

items.question: App is slow or stuck
items.answer: Try restarting the app. If the issue continues, contact support and include your device model and app version.
